description: Land Title Settlement Department - Meddegama, Dompe D/S Division, Gampaha  District - Cad. Map No. 5110104
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding ownership of specific land parcels. It contains detailed schedules listing land parcel numbers, owners, addresses, extent of land, title classifications, and encumbrances (mortgages, servitude rights). The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" as defined in Type 4, focusing on land registrations and title determinations rather than government personnel, organizational changes, or other specialized categories.
